title: Place a table. Make it yours.
caption: Drag a table onto the plan, animate its chairs and try a round shape.

title: Copy the table. Style the whole row.
caption: Hold Ctrl to drag out copies, then select the row and apply one appearance.

title: Draw the table. Add chairs one by one.

title: Drag in an arc. Shape the audience.
caption: Drop curved seating in the center, adjust rows and columns, then try the viewer.

caption: Drag in a ready-made bus and give its seats a coordinated transport appearance.

title: Choose your seats. Review your tickets.
caption: Explore the plan, choose your places and review the total on your phone.
